## zipzi.values.Parameter

```python
class Parameter(Value)
```

Authored document parameter whose stable ID identifies it in bindings and evaluation.

| Field | Type | Constructor default (wire JSON) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `str` | Required | Stable document object ID used by references; it is distinct from the exported runtime_id. |
| `runtime_id` | `str` | Required | External format/runtime identifier retained for import/export; not the document object ID. |
| `name` | `str` | Required | Human-readable display name; use the stable ID for identity because names can change. |
| `minimum` | `float` | Required | Lower endpoint of the parameter domain, in model-defined parameter units. |
| `maximum` | `float` | Required | Upper endpoint of the parameter domain, in the same units as minimum. |
| `default_value` | `float` | Required | Default parameter value used when no override is supplied. |
| `decimal_places` | `int` | `6` | Decimal precision used for runtime parameter handling; native default is 6. |
| `kind` | `ParameterKind` | `"normal"` | Normal or BlendShape parameter behavior; native default is Normal. |
| `repeat` | `bool` | `false` | Whether parameter values repeat across the declared range; native default is false. |

## zipzi.values.ParameterPatch

Partial replacement of a parameter's authored fields.
Omitted or None fields preserve their current values; supplied values are validated as replacements.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
